Multiview fish trajectories and underwater refraction

Source: vignettes/articles/multiview-3d.Rmd
multiview-3d.Rmd

Multiview reconstruction and physical geometry

Adding a second camera can provide 3D information only when the physical mapping and correspondence problem is supported. Two uncalibrated fish videos do not magically provide measured depth.

Conceptual illustration; the straight lines do not assert the measured ray bending of any actual GoPro setup.

Step 1 — Synchronize observation times

Camera timestamps can differ due to drift and offset. aqt_sync_holdout_fit() estimates a supported affine timing model against independently matched events and holds out markers for checking. aqt_sync_holdout_apply() preserves source time stamps and rejects unsupported extrapolation.

Fitted timestamp agreement is not automatically hardware exposure synchronization.

Step 2 — Declare and test the camera model

Camera condition Methods Scientific warning
Idealized air-only projection aqt_rig_new(), aqt_rig_project() Inappropriate for uncorrected underwater refraction
Single flat air/water interface aqt_refractive_camera(), aqt_refractive_rays() One interface only
Parallel glass slab, air–glass–water aqt_flatport_camera(), aqt_flatport_rays() Requires measured glass and optical parameters
Perspective radial/tangential distortion aqt_brown_camera(), aqt_brown_undistort_pixels() Not a universal fisheye correction

The actual physical tank coordinate system, lens intrinsics/extrinsics, medium indices, glass thickness and port configuration must be supplied. No function independently certifies their accuracy just because the code runs.

Step 3 — Match fish between camera views

aqt_view_candidates() and aqt_candidate_rank() help examine possible paired observations. aqt_refractive_view_candidates() generates physically based candidate rays; aqt_crossview_auto_associate() produces provisional, abstention-capable track links.

aqt_auto_refractive_pipeline() combines candidate association with supported refractive reconstruction. The output is not guaranteed to be a permanent individual fish ID; source IDs and abstentions must be reported.

Step 4 — Reconstruct and audit XYZ

aqt_reconstruct_3d() handles externally known pinhole correspondences where appropriate; aqt_refractive_reconstruct_tracks() handles declared refractive geometry and reviewed pairs. aqt_reconstruction_quality() and aqt_refractive_track_quality() summarize supported diagnostic quantities.

Step 5 — Validate against measured targets

Held-out measured target positions are the critical external anchor. aqt_target_trial_table(), aqt_target_holdout_benchmark(), aqt_stereo_landmark_benchmark() and aqt_stereo_depth_audit() support quality evaluation when true surveyed XYZ coordinates are available.

A low reprojection error can coexist with a wrong fish identity or wrong physical camera model.
